name: pricing
tagline_zh: 别再拍脑袋定价了。从免费增值到按席位，它帮你拆解每个定价陷阱，甚至告诉你何时该涨价，像身边有个定价老手。
tagline_en: Stop guessing prices. From freemium to per-seat, it dissects every pricing trap and tells you when to raise.
desc_en: When the user wants help with pricing decisions, packaging, or monetization strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'pricing,' 'pricing tiers,' 'freemium,' 'free trial,' 'packaging,' 'price increase,' 'value metric,' 'Van Westendorp,' 'willingness to pay,' 'monetization,' 'how much should I charge,' 'my pricing is wrong,' 'pricing page,' 'annual vs monthly,' 'per seat pricing,' 'should I offer a
why_zh: 它不只给建议，更会追问你的价值指标和支付意愿，逼你理清逻辑，而非套模板。
why_en: It doesn't just advise—it probes your value metric and willingness to pay, forcing clarity over cookie-cutter answers.
